title: Mary Baker Eddy: angels, discord is not music, and 'lay out'
summary: Thomas links Eddy's line that discord is not music to Jelly's 'If you get lost, lay out' and they close on mental discipline.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: So in conclusion, you said you wanted to say something about Mary Baker Eddy.

Oh yeah. And there's one other thought that I found out -- the meaning of angels. Angels are God's thoughts coming to man. Now, I'm not quoting that verbatim; I can look it up and quote it verbatim. It says angels are God's thoughts coming to man.
Well, that doesn't too much bear on what we're talking about in conclusion, your advice to give young
But about Mary Baker Eddy. You said you wanted in conclusion to give her credit...
Yeah, I found that... And she has so many... See, I'm involved with music, so I want to make these remarks concerning music. She said so many important things about music.

Mary Baker Eddy, Science and Health. Because she made one statement that says, 'Discord is not music.' And we know that. Because when a cat gets up and plays a wrong note... That's one Jelly Roll Morton had to say. 'if you get lost, lay out.' Because he didn't want you to make no bad notes. And that was an easy thing to do, because if you got lost, just keep horn in your mouth and keeping playing like you're playing, and when you find the right place to...the right number to come in, you come in. But he said it in a funny way, because see, if you're trying to catch up, you're going to be playing bad notes until you catch up.
So in conclusion, that's what you want to say, Foots?
Well, thank you. I can't think of anything I can say to add to that, except...

These pointers I gave... I had to reminisce on the things that I think helped me. And they are ordinary things that can help anybody. The only thing I was a little lax on mentioning was mathematics, because mathematics you really need to get it from the beginning all the way up.

Well, I imagine that Christianity or religion... I'm not too much into your particular religion, although I followed you and worshipped you and tried to listen to you. But I think any kind of mental discipline is what's very much involved in music...

And this is what you use this medium of the Christian Science to do that. And so you were you suggesting, and I was also suggesting that any young people should try to get some sort of a mental discipline or some sort of a moral...
